home_rows.advantage: The tramway is the east fan's air path; cutters on the station deck throw across the cable while you hang on it.
home_rows.counter: Drop off the cable early onto the Ore Bench or glide under the arc; the deck sits level with the saddle's east lip, so a ram from the lip reaches it.

home_rows.advantage: Trestle tops overlook the grind; a cut line drops you off the chute's high end onto the net.
home_rows.counter: Grind it low and fast: the reticle closes on where you will be, and the chute's speed carries you past it.

home_rows.advantage: Ballast crews post up along the mooring rim over the net; no damage wears them down.
home_rows.counter: Ram them off the rim into the net, hardest while they brace to slam; come in fast off the roost ferry.

home_rows.advantage: The landed dropship's ramp is a ballast deck facing the net; it doubles the moorings' crew.
home_rows.counter: Its ramp is also a kicker: roll up it at speed and ram the heavies off the deck edge.

home_rows.advantage: The roost's sunny face holds a thermal that keeps them above ram reach.
home_rows.counter: Shoot them while they circle or leave the dive mark; Kest rides the same column above them and slams.

home_rows.advantage: The lookout line is the grapple run's first hook; cutters on the mesa's east shoulder throw across it as you hook on.
home_rows.counter: Hook on at speed off the step lip and ride it long, or ram the shoulder post on the way down the steps.
